access: dedicated read-only SQL, schema inspected first
scope: Existing public-post eligibility filter (trimmed tags exclude טיוטה and פורום); public-gallery identities; aggregate path family traffic over all retained rows. SQL identity census is not HTTP/canonical acceptance or proof of Google indexing.

posts.query: select id,slug,wp_id,source,regexp_replace(link,'[?#].*$','') as link from public.posts where not exists(select 1 from unnest(tags) tag where trim(tag) in ('טיוטה','פורום')) order by id;

projection.meaning: Same canonical source adapter, source projection only; no per-URL HTTP acceptance.

classification_summary.query: with p as (select id,categories,tags,author from public.posts where not exists(select 1 from unnest(tags) tag where trim(tag) in ('טיוטה','פורום'))) select 'public_posts_by_existing_boundary' as kind,count(*) as count from p union all select 'distinct_category_labels',count(distinct value) from p cross join lateral unnest(categories) value union all select 'distinct_tag_labels',count(distinct value) from p cross join lateral unnest(tags) value union all select 'nonempty_author_labels',count(distinct nullif(trim(author),'')) from p;

internal_links.query: with p as (select id,content from public.posts where not exists(select 1 from unnest(tags) tag where trim(tag) in ('טיוטה','פורום'))), links as (select p.id, m[1] as href from p cross join lateral regexp_matches(content,$re$href\s*=\s*["']([^"'<>[:space:]]+)["']$re$,'gi') m), own as (select id,case when href ~* '^https?://(www\.)?sod1820\.co\.il(/|$)' then regexp_replace(href,'^https?://(www\.)?sod1820\.co\.il','','i') when href ~* '^https?://sod1820\.vercel\.app(/|$)' then regexp_replace(href,'^https?://sod1820\.vercel\.app','','i') else href end as href from links where href ~* '^https?://((www\.)?sod1820\.co\.il|sod1820\.vercel\.app)(/|$)' or href ~ '^/[^/]'), safe as (select id,regexp_replace(href,'[?#].*$','') as path,(position('?' in href)>0) as has_query,(position('#' in href)>0) as has_anchor from own where href !~* '^/(auth|unsubscribe|profile|account|login|admin|api)(/|\?|$)' and href !~ '@') select path,count(*) as link_occurrences,count(distinct id) as source_posts,bool_or(has_query) as has_query,bool_or(has_anchor) as has_anchor,(array_agg(distinct id))[1:3] as example_post_ids from safe group by path order by link_occurrences desc;

media_links.query: with p as (select id,content from public.posts where not exists(select 1 from unnest(tags) tag where trim(tag) in ('טיוטה','פורום'))), links as (select p.id,m[1] as attribute,m[2] as href from p cross join lateral regexp_matches(content,$re$(src|poster)\s*=\s*["']([^"'<>[:space:]]+)["']$re$,'gi') m), own as (select id,attribute,case when href ~* '^https?://(www\.)?sod1820\.co\.il(/|$)' then regexp_replace(href,'^https?://(www\.)?sod1820\.co\.il','','i') when href ~* '^https?://sod1820\.vercel\.app(/|$)' then regexp_replace(href,'^https?://sod1820\.vercel\.app','','i') else href end as href from links where href ~* '^https?://((www\.)?sod1820\.co\.il|sod1820\.vercel\.app)(/|$)' or href ~ '^/[^/]') select regexp_replace(href,'[?#].*$','') as path,attribute,count(*) as occurrences,count(distinct id) as source_posts from own where href !~ '@' group by path,attribute order by occurrences desc;

traffic_families.query: with paths as (select 'site_visits' as source,regexp_replace(coalesce(path,''),'[?#].*$','') as path,ts from public.site_visits union all select 'events',regexp_replace(coalesce(path,''),'[?#].*$',''),ts from public.events), classified as (select source,ts,case when path in ('','/') then '/' when path ~ '^/(?:chat|chatroom|chat-room|community|forum|chats|social)(/|$)' then substring(path from '^/[^/]+') when path ~ '^/(?:category|tag|author|writer|contributor|number|n|gematria|calculator|calc|gallery|galleries|video|media|codes|code|els|heichal|book|books|contact|privacy|subscribe|unsubscribe|login|auth|register|account|profile|world|posts|post|2029|campaign|donate|donation|checkout|payment|search|sitemap)(/|$)' then substring(path from '^/[^/]+') when path ~ '^/[^/]+/?$' then '[single segment: post candidate or unknown]' else '[other nested: not exported raw]' end as family from paths) select source,family,count(*) as observations,min(ts) as first_at,max(ts) as last_at from classified group by source,family order by source,observations desc;

legacy_traffic_summary.query: select source,count(*) as rows,min(period) as first_period,max(period) as last_period,count(url) as rows_with_url from public.legacy_traffic group by source order by source;

galleries.query: select id,wp_gallery_id,name from public.galleries order by wp_gallery_id nulls last,id;
galleries.exportScope: Historical wp_gallery_id only; gallery names/UUIDs omitted; count is not proof of public eligibility.

collections.query: select slug,title,is_active,is_premium from public.gallery_collections order by id;

imagecounts.query: select count(*) as all_images,count(*) filter(where published=1 and curator_hidden is not true and coalesce(min_tier,0)=0) as zero_tier_published_not_hidden,count(distinct gallery_id) filter(where published=1 and curator_hidden is not true and coalesce(min_tier,0)=0) as galleries_with_zero_tier_public_candidate from public.gallery_images;

public_contributor_slugs.query: select slug,display_name,kind from public.contributors where active is true and locked is not true and building is not true and coalesce(dossier_settings->>'visibility','public')='public' order by slug;

limitations: HTML extraction covers quoted href/src/poster on own domains and root-relative links; not Markdown/unquoted/relative-without-root/srcset/CSS URLs or links inside comments/source documents/user journals.
Queries/fragments stripped before export; has_query/has_anchor retained for public hrefs. Private/auth/unsubscribe/profile/account/login/admin/api hrefs excluded. Do not infer they are nonexistent.

Telemetry query scans all retained rows; historical traffic_history2015+ contains totals not routes. Not external Google/SearchConsole/hosting-log coverage; mixed bots/tests/Preview possible, not unique humans.
Public metadata counts are inventory candidates, not proof every endpoint resolves/visible anonymously. video_asset_rows count before canonical source readmission is notpubliccoverage.
No private content, account/visitor IDs, IPs, full query tokens, raw user metadata or content exported. No writes/models/mail/network tests.
